Shipped migration material: scripts/deploy/staging_ops.sh invokes prod_preflight.py migration render against services/trade_journey/migrations (failing closed with MIGRATION_RENDER_FAILED if digest != manifest.migration_set_sha256), packages migration-material.tar.gz into the staging bundle, deploy/staging/bootstrap.sh installs it to ${STAGING_ROOT}/state/migration-material/, and pantheon-staging-collect-gates reads migration-spec.json and migrations/*.sql from that release-owned path.

3. Compose --env-file precedence: pantheon-staging-collect-gates records keys loaded from state/compose.env into _COMPOSE_ENV_KEYS and strips them from merged_env in _run() whenever --env-file is on the command line so --env-file compose.baseline.env starts the baseline image.

4. Bounded BFF readiness polling (_wait_bff_ready using STAGING_OWNER_READY_TIMEOUT / STAGING_READY_INTERVAL): added at all four owner-restart points (old-app start before /bff/readyz and /bff/version, post-migration candidate restore, rollback leg after _wait_product_owners() within rollback_duration_seconds, and restore leg reordered so _wait_product_owners() runs before /bff/readyz).

5. PostgreSQL 16 client tools: bootstrap.sh and pantheon-staging-collect-gates execute psql, pg_dump, and pg_restore inside the running digest-pinned postgres:16 container via docker exec -e PGPASSWORD (with ${STAGING_DATA_MOUNT}/backups and ${STAGING_ROOT}/state/migration-material mounted in deploy/staging/docker-compose.staging.yml) so Debian 12's host pg_dump 15.19 never aborts against server 16.15.

6. Python 3.11.2 tarfile compatibility: _safe_extract_tar validates every archive member first (rejecting empty, absolute, '..', escaping targets, symlinks, hardlinks, FIFOs, and device nodes) and falls back cleanly when TarFile.extractall() raises TypeError on filter='data'.

7. Compose profile dependencies on rm: pantheon-staging-collect-gates passes --profile core --profile singleton on both lifecycle-projector drains and --profile core when removing baseline_absent_owners.

8. Atomic owner-store backup and manifest: section 4 snapshots durable owner stores into a temporary directory before pg_dump and computes both owner_manifest_sha and owner_backup_file from that single frozen copy.
9. Section 6 fresh short-lived JWTs: _mint_probe_tokens() mints 300s operator_token and viewer_token before section 3 and again right before section 6.

10. Capacity: deploy/staging/staging-env.defaults and scripts/deploy/staging_provision.sh fallback set STAGING_MACHINE_TYPE=e2-standard-8 (8 vCPU / 32 GB) without relaxing the 120s rollback RTO limit, timeouts, or health checks.

Passing the collector bundle (>128 KiB because migration_plan carries full old_app_schema and new_schema live catalogs) to python3 via the SSH_VERIFY_OUT environment variable exceeded Linux MAX_ARG_STRLEN (128 KiB) with E2BIG; the failure branch at staging_ops.sh:622 (SSH_VERIFY_OUT) and deploy readback branch at staging_ops.sh:499 (SSH_DEPLOY_OUT) used the same pattern.
fix: scripts/deploy/staging_ops.sh unsets SSH_DEPLOY_OUT and SSH_VERIFY_OUT at entry, writes deploy-host SSH output directly to a 0600 file ${STATE_DIR}/artifacts/${RELEASE_ID}-ssh-deploy.out and collect-verify-gates SSH output directly to a 0600 file ${STATE_DIR}/artifacts/${RELEASE_ID}-ssh-verify.out (plus 0600 artifact/manifest summary files), and has all python3 and grep consumers (:499, :622, :661, and artifact inspection helpers) read the file path instead of passing outputs through environment variables or argv.

scripts/deploy/staging_verify.sh writes collect-verify-gates output, manifest validation summary, and all six gate verifier outputs to 0600 files under ${STATE_DIR}/artifacts/ and reads them by file path in python3 while keeping all gate parsing semantics, required sections, error codes, and observed_from_live_vm/dry_run checks identical without dropping or truncating bundle content.

drill7_governance_posture_and_core_owner.root_cause: Zero-start drill 7 (run 41487918716 on dev a1eb43880) failed Stage 3 with ROLLBACK_VERIFICATION_FAILED: exact-pair rollback duration must be <= 120 seconds (got 163.541), phase_timings_seconds: drain 1.132s, baseline_up 120.733s, owners_healthy 40.25s, readyz_200 0.015s, readback 1.41s. Two staging-contract defects caused both the 120.7s recreate stall and a gate blind spot: (1) deploy/staging/docker-compose.staging.yml omitted GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND=postgres and GOVERNANCE_AUDIT_BACKEND=postgres on governance (plus MANAGEMENT_AI_STORE_BACKEND=postgres on operator-bff), so governance defaulted to json under PANTHEON_ENV=staging and exited 1 in services.foundation.persistence_posture.require_persistence_posture on every restart; (2) _wait_product_owners in deploy/staging/pantheon-staging-collect-gates checked only PRODUCT_OWNER_IMAGE_KEYS and only a single State.Running==true sample without verifying RestartCount stability across observations in the wait window, allowing crash-looping core owners (governance and deployment) caught between restarts with Running=true to pass.
fix: deploy/staging/docker-compose.staging.yml sets GOVERNANCE_STORE_BACKEND: postgres and GOVERNANCE_AUDIT_BACKEND: postgres on governance and MANAGEMENT_AI_STORE_BACKEND: postgres on operator-bff, matching dev so every staging compose owner started with PANTHEON_ENV=staging passes services.foundation.persistence_posture.validate_persistence_posture.

deploy/staging/docker-compose.staging.yml adds standard urllib /health healthchecks (interval: 10s, timeout: 5s, retries: 10, start_period: 15s) to governance (http://127.0.0.1:8082/health) and deployment (http://127.0.0.1:8095/health).

deploy/staging/pantheon-staging-collect-gates expands _wait_product_owners(skip) to cover REQUIRED_OWNER_IMAGE_KEYS (core + product, honoring skip), requiring each owner on a passing sample to be running, healthy where a healthcheck exists, have continuous uptime (now minus State.StartedAt) >= STAGING_OWNER_MIN_UPTIME_SECONDS (default 15s), and have an unchanged (cid, RestartCount) compared against the immediately preceding sample (preventing both false passes from crash-looping containers caught in a 3-5s Running=true window with unchanged RestartCount and false permanent failures when an owner restarts once early during startup and then stays stable, failing fast only when all unserved owners have increased RestartCount on >= 3 consecutive samples). Unserved core owners are reported with structure-only diagnostics (container status/exit_code/oom_killed/restart_count/error_present, /workspace/services/... traceback frames, and public exception types; never env values or raw messages with secrets) across initial, rollback, and restore legs without excluding any wait from rollback_duration_seconds.
